verdict.rationale: n8n's source is publicly readable on GitHub, but under the fair-code Sustainable Use License rather than an OSI-approved open-source license. A community member confirms it is 'source-available' and 'Not really OSS', which matches n8n's own description, so this is a limitation rather than a dispute. missing for 10: an OSI-approved open-source license, and documentation of what the Sustainable Use License actually permits (reading, modification, redistribution).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: A standard, self-hosted version of n8n is available on GitHub.
n8n is a fair-code licensed workflow automation tool
n8n's Sustainable Use License and n8n Enterprise License are based on the fair-code model.
N8n is a Free and source-available fair-code licensed workflow automation tool. Not really OSS.
